source_clause: EH4.) When the AUTO function is off and available, the user s first press of the AUTO button will activate the AUTO ECO functionality.
reasoning: 驗證目標：10.4（EH4）定出 AUTO 關閉且可用時之第一次按壓啟動 AUTO ECO，單一 037 leaf 對應之，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：第十五軸依 R-C29 標 (10.1)；「AUTO 關閉且可用」為 spec 定義之 trigger，惟 TC 自身之步驟即可建立，依 **R-C28 第三問**落 test_procedure 而不入 pre_conditions；依 R-C34 補第十三軸排除，EMEA ICS 不補。為什麼這樣切：本節只定出第一次按壓之結果，第二、三次按壓由 10.5 各自成條。刻意略過：條文之「available」未定義其不可用之條件，故不寫入任何可用性判定（§8.4.1）。

interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab

interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不補** —— ch16 十八節無 ECO HVAC 之對應節（`ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 ch10 側全無列），排除即無所依據；本組非 no-counterpart 之「已列而無對造」，而是 ch10 從未進入該表之比對範圍，理由相同：ch16 不承載此章之能力

tcs.tc_title: First AUTO press activates AUTO ECO
tcs.test_item:
EH4.) When the AUTO function is off and available, the user s first press of the AUTO button will activate the AUTO ECO functionality.

(press the AUTO button once -> The AUTO ECO functionality is activated)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EV vehicle, on which ECO HVAC is used (10.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the AUTO button until AUTO is off
2. Press the AUTO button once
tcs.expected_result:
1. The AUTO state is AUTO OFF
2. The AUTO ECO functionality is activated
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item_authored: When the AUTO function is off and available, the user's first press of the AUTO button shall activate the AUTO ECO functionality
